registered_before: the F1 closure exam set is generated (rulings U1 revision, 2026-11-04 07:40 PT: void/rerun rules are written before the questions)

pairing.order_note: repetition r of the i-th scenario (dataset order) puts opspilot first when (i + r) is even, holmes first otherwise; alert-entry windows run opspilot alone

spacing.same_scenario_gap_from: the earlier window's fault restored (normal confirmed) to the later window's injection
spacing.wash_from: a window's fault restored (normal confirmed) to the next injection on the same lab

void_rerun.rerun_note: rerun_slot repeats only the failed system's slot in a new window of its own (same injection plan); rerun_pair repeats the whole window, both systems in the planned order, so the pair stays symmetric; every voided slot stays in voided_attempts

classes.when: on a shared-vCPU host only (U7): any slot of the window has CPU steal strictly above 5 percent, or the window's baseline checkout p95 is strictly above twice the S5 probe baseline
classes.note: host noise, pair rerun per rule

classes.when: a telemetry store container of the lab (jaeger, prometheus-server) restarted or was replaced between the window's pre-injection baseline and the end of its wash (pod/container restart counts differ), e.g. Jaeger OOMKilled under the homepage flood, which wipes the trace store
classes.note: lab store restarted, rerun per rule

classes.when: the driver was interrupted or crashed (exit 130, exit 4 retained fault recovered by --recover) before both slots of the window finished

a slot ended setup_failed before its own Run was created (lab, PG, injection, pre-observation gate or its re-confirmation before the second system, HolmesGPT container start); a slot whose Run was created is scored as it ended
classes.note: environment not ready, rerun per rule

classes.when: a slot's Run ended on a model provider failure: its last model call failed as unavailable (provider HTTP 5xx or connection failure, after the system's own retries), and the scenario injects no model transport fault

void_rerun.after_rerun: a rerun (pair or slot) counts as it ends, whatever class it fails with; it is never rerun in turn
never_void: a wrong, missing or invalid answer of either system
a system timing out, exhausting its step or token budget, or refusing
a Run that started and failed on anything outside the classes above
contamination flags (reported per slot, with a sensitivity row that excludes flagged slots)
a scheduling gap or wash shorter than the minimum (reported as a schedule violation, never silently dropped)
void_rerun.precedence: HOST_NOISE, LAB_RESTARTED, HARNESS_INTERRUPTED, ENV_SETUP_FAILED, PROVIDER_5XX_STORM: the first class that applies decides

denominator: every started slot counts; a voided slot leaves the score but stays in voided_attempts; a planned slot that never started counts as a failure

lab_state.restore_unconfirmed: a window that injected and has no confirmed restore, a driver exit 4 (retained fault) or an interrupted window stops its lab: no later window starts there and the wash and same-scenario gap are not advanced until an engineer ran eval_live --recover; the lab's pending windows go to the other labs
